summary: Morrison County, MN 90-ft steel ladder tower erected 1937 on a hill by Sullivan Lake; listed as gone, with no removal date or account of the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure with an observation room and an exterior ladder
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; the sources read give no removal date or method
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (owner listed as Mn MFS; now Minnesota DNR Forestry Division)

events.note: Completed in 1937 as a 90-foot steel ladder tower; county survey entry gives 'erected in 1937'
Sept 30, 1937: CCC crews putting telephone wire from Garrison fire towers to the Sullivan Lake tower (Brainerd Daily Dispatch, quoted on the site)
1960 survey notes describe a four-legged steel structure with an observation room and an overall height of 100 feet

corrections.why: 42N-28-18 is a location code, not an owner. The county survey table lists the owner as Mn MFS, and its footnote gives Minnesota Forest Service.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives a 90-foot steel tower with an exterior ladder, and the county survey calls it a 90-foot ladder tower. The same survey's 1960 notes give an overall height of 100 feet. The record keeps 27.4 m (90 ft), the figure both sources give for the ladder tower, and the 100-ft overall figure is noted here.

notes_for_editor: Two independent sources agree on the 1937 build and the 90-ft ladder tower, and the FFLA list says gone. No source gives a removal date, method or site description, so the story says nothing about the site beyond the status. The brief's agency value was a location code and is corrected. Morrison County PDF has no named publisher on the file; its provenance is unverified. The 1937 CCC telephone-wire item comes from a newspaper quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, not from the newspaper itself.
